question: Which Ca/C ratio was chosen for the temperature experiments of the carbide slag-assisted sewage sludge steam gasification, and how much carbide slag did that ratio take per 10.0 g of sludge?
rendered:
According to the excerpt [Carbide Slag-Assisted Steam Gasification of Sewage Sludge for Hydrogen-Rich Syngas Production and Heavy Metal Stabilization, page 8], the Ca/C ratio chosen for the temperature experiments was 0.50. 

According to the excerpt [Carbide Slag-Assisted Steam Gasification of Sewage Sludge for Hydrogen-Rich Syngas Production and Heavy Metal Stabilization, page 3], the corresponding CS mass for Ca/C = 0.50 was 7.39 g per 10.0 g of SS.
